cases.sql: WITH s AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT nextval('prefix_effects') AS v FROM generate_series(1,5)) SELECT v FROM s LIMIT 1

WITH s AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT nextval('prefix_effects') AS v FROM generate_series(1,5)) SELECT (SELECT v FROM s LIMIT 1) AS first,(SELECT v FROM s OFFSET 2 LIMIT 1) AS third,(SELECT v FROM s LIMIT 1) AS replay
WITH s AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT nextval('prefix_effects') AS v FROM generate_series(1,5)) SELECT a.v AS first,b.v AS second FROM s a CROSS JOIN s b LIMIT 1
WITH s AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT nextval('prefix_effects') AS v FROM generate_series(1,5)) SELECT 9 AS v
WITH s AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT nextval('prefix_effects') AS v FROM generate_series(1,5)) SELECT v FROM s LIMIT 0
WITH s AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT nextval('prefix_effects') AS v FROM generate_series(1,5)) SELECT sum(v) AS total FROM s
WITH s AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT nextval('prefix_effects') AS v UNION ALL SELECT nextval('prefix_effects')) SELECT v FROM s LIMIT 1
WITH s(v) AS MATERIALIZED(VALUES(nextval('prefix_effects')),(nextval('prefix_effects'))) SELECT v FROM s LIMIT 1
WITH a AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT nextval('prefix_effects') AS v FROM generate_series(1,5)), b AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT v+10 AS w FROM a) SELECT w FROM b LIMIT 1
WITH s AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT nextval('prefix_effects') AS v FROM generate_series(1,5) ORDER BY v) SELECT v FROM s LIMIT 1
WITH s AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT count(*) AS n,nextval('prefix_effects') AS v FROM generate_series(1,4) g(i) GROUP BY i) SELECT n,v FROM s LIMIT 1
WITH s AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT 10/x AS v FROM (VALUES(2),(0))q(x)) SELECT v FROM s LIMIT 1
WITH s AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT 10/x AS v FROM (VALUES(2),(0))q(x)) SELECT v FROM s
WITH s AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT x FROM (VALUES(2),(0))q(x) WHERE 10/x>1) SELECT x FROM s LIMIT 1
WITH s AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT 10/x AS v FROM (VALUES(2),(0))q(x)) SELECT (SELECT v FROM s LIMIT 1) AS a,(SELECT v FROM s OFFSET 1 LIMIT 1) AS b
WITH s AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT 10/x AS v FROM (VALUES(2),(0))q(x) UNION ALL SELECT 10) SELECT v FROM s LIMIT 1
SELECT q.x,r.v FROM (VALUES(2),(4))q(x) CROSS JOIN LATERAL(WITH s AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT q.x+i AS v FROM generate_series(1,3)g(i)) SELECT v FROM s LIMIT 1)r
WITH a AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT 7 AS v), b AS MATERIALIZED(WITH a AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT v+1 AS v FROM a) SELECT v FROM a) SELECT v FROM b
CREATE VIEW prefix_view AS WITH s AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT nextval('prefix_effects') AS v FROM generate_series(1,5)) SELECT v FROM s
WITH s AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT generate_series(1,3) AS i,nextval('prefix_effects') AS v) SELECT i,v FROM s LIMIT 1
DECLARE prefix_cursor SCROLL CURSOR FOR WITH s AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT nextval('prefix_effects') AS v FROM generate_series(1,5)) SELECT v FROM s
